author: nickyeow

english.text: The point is whether she will come or not.

jyutping: man6 tai4 hai6 keoi5 dou3 dai2 lai4 ding6 hai6 m4 lai4。
text: 問題係佢到底嚟定係唔嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Raw fish easily goes bad.

jyutping: saang1 ge3 jyu4 hou2 ji6 bin3 waai6。
text: 生嘅魚好易變壞。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Strictly speaking, the theory is not correct.

jyutping: jim4 gaak3 di1 gong2，ni1 tou3 lei5 leon6 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 ngaam1。
text: 嚴格啲講，呢套理論唔可以話係啱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did the newspaper say it was going to rain?

jyutping: bou3 zi2 jau5 mou5 waa6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 aa3？
text: 報紙有冇話會落雨呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Judging from the present look of the sky, we may have a downpour any moment.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 go3 tin1 gam3 ge3 fun2，tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 ceoi4 si4 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5 gam3 wo3。
text: 而家個天咁嘅款，睇落好似隨時會落大雨咁喎。

author: minshirui

english.text: I do not understand.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 ming4。
text: 我唔明。

author: Riko

english.text: It is getting dark. Let's go home.

jyutping: tin1 dou1 hoi1 ci2 haak1 laa3。faan1 uk1 kei2 lo1！
text: 天都開始黑喇。返屋企囉！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I didn't tell him the truth for fear he would get angry.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zan1 waa6，jan1 wai6 ngo5 geng1 keoi5 wui5 niu5。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You might at least say thank you.

jyutping: nei5 zi3 siu2 dou1 gong2 faan2 geoi3 do1 ze6 aa1。
text: 你至少都講返句多謝吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Does that include breakfast?

jyutping: baau1 m4 baau1 maai4 zou2 caan1 gaa3？
text: 包唔包埋早餐㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where are they going to right now?

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 gan2 bin1？

author: nickyeow

english.text: That book had a lot of pages.

jyutping: go2 bun2 syu1 jau5 hou2 do1 baan2。
text: 嗰本書有好多版。

english.text: What a dictionary says is not always right.

jyutping: zi6 din2 mei6 bit1 jat1 ding6 hai6 ngaam1 ge3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I burned myself with boiling water.

jyutping: ngo5 bei2 gwan2 seoi2 luk6 can1。

author: kaenif

english.text: He crossed his legs.

jyutping: keoi5 kiu3 maai4 deoi3 goek3。

author: kaenif

english.text: The cat ate the mouse.

jyutping: zek3 maau1 sik6 zo2 zek3 lou5 syu2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Talk slower.
Speak slower.

jyutping: gong2 maan6 siu2 siu2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: As far as I go, I'm a cook. The only thing I do is prepare the food.

jyutping: naa4 ngo5 ne1，a6 cyu4 si1 lai4 ge3 zek1。ngo5 zing6 hai6 fu6 zaak3 zyu2 je5 sik6 gaa3 zaa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There's almost no milk left in the glass.

jyutping: go3 bui1 jap6 min6 mou5 mat1 ngau4 naai5 zing6 laa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Neither Tom nor Mary can swim.

jyutping: aa3 Tom tung4 Mary dou1 m4 sik1 jau4 seoi2。
text: 阿Tom同Mary都唔識游水。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You're a patient man.

jyutping: nei5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3 ge3 jan4。
text: 你係一個好有耐性嘅人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He used to eat out every day, but now he can't afford it.

jyutping: keoi5 ji5 cin4 jat6 jat6 ceot1 gaai1 sik6 faan6 gaa3，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 mou5 lou1，jan1 wai6 mou5 cin2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where did you learn French?

jyutping: nei5 di1 faat3 man4 hai2 bin1 dou3 hok6 faan1 lai4 gaa3？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla went to the church to pray for Sami.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 heoi3 zo2 gaau3 tong4 dou3 wai6 sam1 mei5 kei4 tou2。
text: 蕾拉去咗教堂到為森美祈禱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I promise I'll pay you back.

jyutping: ngo5 bou2 zing3 ngo5 wui5 waan4 faan1 cin4 bei2 nei5。
text: 我保證我會還返錢俾你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm bored. I'll watch TV.

jyutping: hou2 mun6 aa3，tai2 din6 si6 sin1。

english.text: Tom can't do this as well as I can.

jyutping: aa3 Tom zou6 m4 dou2 hou2 ci5 ngo5 gam3 hou2。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: Shut up! Stop! Mind your own business.

jyutping: sau1 pei4 laa1 nei5！

english.text: Is your son studying in university?

author: thesilhouette

english.text: He said he'd be back.

jyutping: keoi4 waa6 wui5 faan2 loi4 go2 bo3。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: He looks angry.

jyutping: keoi5 tai2 lok6 heoi3 hou2 niu5。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the afternoon of the 23rd of February of 2022, at the cafe, I sat at my favourite corner table to drink my iced green tea, which on other times, I alternate with iced passionfruit tea and iced black tea. Hans the Netherlander hobby astronomer sat at a central table. There were young people with strange hairdos, like samurai top knot, or big and curly, or long and red-tinted. Homebound, I had to use the washroom in the pizzeria, where there were Eurasian students.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 2 jyut6 23 hou6 ge3 haa6 zau3，hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 zo6 hai2 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 gok3 lok6 toi2 dou6 jam2 ngo5 ge3 bing1 luk6 caa4，ji4 hai2 kei4 taa1 si4 gaan3，ngo5 wui5 gaau1 tai3 jam2 bing1 jit6 cing4 gwo2 caa4 tung4 bing1 hak1 caa4。ho4 laan1 jan4 ge3 tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 hon3 si1 zo6 hai2 jat1 zoeng1 zung1 joeng1 toi2 dou6。jau5 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 ge3 faat3 jing4 hou3 kei4 gwaai3，hou2 ci5 mou5 si6 ding2 git3，waak6 ze2 daai6 dak1 zai6 ji4 gyun2 maai4 jat1 gau6，waak6 ze2 coeng4 dou3 bin3 saai3 hung4 sik1。faan1 uk1 kei2，ngo5 jiu3 jung6 bok6 beng2 pou2 ge3 sai2 sau2 gaan1，go2 dou6 jau5 au1 aa3 hok6 saang1。
text: 喺2022年2月23號嘅下晝，喺咖啡館，我坐喺我最鍾意嘅角落枱度飲我嘅冰綠茶，而喺其他時間，我會交替飲冰熱情果茶同冰黑茶。荷蘭人嘅天文學家漢斯坐喺一張中央枱度。有啲年輕人嘅髮型好奇怪，好似武士頂結，或者大得滯而捲埋一嚿，或者長到變晒紅色。返屋企，我要用薄餅舖嘅洗手間，嗰度有歐亞學生。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's a sunny blue-sky 19th of June of 2025, here on Lulu Island. The couple of days have passed with my visiting the "Clam Temple," the Roman Catholic church at St. Albans Road, for likely the 47th and 48th times this year. I'm really Dharmoanimistic, a Syncretist in a wider view. Near Robinson Road, I notice the little charming green bamboo grove. Near Bowcock Road, the grand Empress Tree, "Kiri" for Japanese, is now completely devoid of its springtime purple blooms. I visit Tim Hortons café quite frequently: Bacon Farmer's Wrap, buttered Cinnamon Raisin Bagel, Iced Coffee with oat milk, and Iced Classic Lemonade.

jyutping: 2025 nin4 6 jyut6 19 hou6，hai6 jat1 go3 cing4 long5 ge3 laam4 tin1，nei1 dou6 hai6 lou6 lou6 dou2。ne1 gei2 jat6 gwo3 heoi3，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2「gap3 lei4 miu2」，gam1 nin4 ho2 nang4 hai6 dai6 47 tung4 48 ci3。ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 fat6 faat3 dung6 mat6 zyu2 ji6 ze2，hai6 jat1 go3 gang3 gwong2 faan6 ge3 gun1 dim2 ge3 hap6 tai2 zyu2 ji6 ze2。hai2 lo4 ban1 seon3 dou6 fu6 gan6，ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3 go2 go3 mai4 jan4 ge3 luk6 sik1 zuk1 lam4。hai2 baau1 fo1 hak1 dou6 fu6 gan6，wang4 wai5 ge3 wong4 hau6 syu6，jat6 man2 ge3「 Kiri 」，ji4 gaa1 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 zo2 keoi5 ceon1 tin1 ge3 zi2 sik1 faa1 do2。 ngo5 gei2 ging1 soeng4 heoi3 Tim Hortons ge3 gaa3 fe1 gun2：jin1 juk6 nung4 fu1 baau1、ngau4 jau4 juk6 gwai3 pou4 tou4 gon1 baak3 gat1 beng2、jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 bing1 gaa3 fe1 tung4 bing1 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2。
text: 2025年6月19號，係一個晴朗嘅藍天，呢度係露露島。呢幾日過去，我去咗聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂「蛤蜊廟」，今年可能係第 47 同 48 次。我真係一個佛法動物主義者，係一個更廣泛嘅觀點嘅合體主義者。喺羅賓遜道附近，我留意到嗰個迷人嘅綠色竹林。喺鮑科克道附近，宏偉嘅皇后樹，日文嘅「 Kiri 」，而家完全冇咗佢春天嘅紫色花朵。 我幾經常去 Tim Hortons 嘅咖啡館：煙肉農夫包、牛油肉桂葡萄乾百吉餅、燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡同冰經典檸檬水。

author: Andrea5437

english.text: The perception of extraterrestrials as gods hinges on human psychology and cultural context. Imagine a scenario: a sleek, shimmering craft descends, and beings emerge who can heal diseases with a touch, manipulate gravity, or communicate telepathically. To a medieval peasant—or even a modern person unfamiliar with advanced tech—this might scream "divine intervention." Anthropologically, we see this pattern in cargo cults of the Pacific, where isolated tribes revered WWII airmen as gods because their planes and goods defied explanation.

jyutping: deoi3 dei6 ngoi6 saang1 mat6 ge3 jing6 zi1 hai6 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 jan4 leoi6 ge3 sam1 lei5 tung4 man4 faa3 bui3 ging2。soeng2 zoeng6 jat1 go3 coeng4 ging2：jat1 gaa3 gwong1 waat6、sim2 sim2 faat3 gwong1 ge3 fei1 syun4 gong3 lok6，jin4 hau6 ceot1 jin6 zo2 ho2 ji5 jung6 jat1 zuk1 zau6 ho2 ji5 zi6 jyu6 zat6 beng6、cou1 zung3 cung5 lik6 waak6 ze2 tau3 gwo3 din6 ci4 gam2 jing3 kau1 tung1 ge3 cyun4 zoi6。deoi3 jyu1 jat1 go3 zung1 sai3 gei2 ge3 nung4 man4 lai4 gong2 —— sam6 zi3 hai6 jat1 go3 m4 suk6 sik1 sin1 zeon3 fo1 gei6 ge3 jin6 doi6 jan4 —— ni1 go3 ho2 nang4 wui5 zim1 giu3「san4 sing3 ge3 gon1 jyu6」。hai2 jan4 leoi6 hok6 soeng6，ngo5 dei6 hai2 taai3 ping4 joeng4 ge3 fo3 wan6 ce4 gaau3 zung1 gin3 dou2 ni1 go3 mou4 sik1，hai2 go2 dou6，gu1 lap6 ge3 bou6 lok6 zoeng1 ji6 zin3 ge3 hung1 bing1 zyun1 wai4 san4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fei1 gei1 tung4 fo3 mat6 m4 nang4 gau3 gaai2 sik1。
text: 對地外生物嘅認知係取決於人類嘅心理同文化背景。想像一個場景：一架光滑、閃閃發光嘅飛船降落，然後出現咗可以用一觸就可以治癒疾病、操縱重力或者透過電磁感應溝通嘅存在。對於一個中世紀嘅農民嚟講 —— 甚至係一個唔熟悉先進科技嘅現代人 —— 呢個可能會尖叫「神聖嘅干預」。喺人類學上，我哋喺太平洋嘅貨運邪教中見到呢個模式，喺嗰度，孤立嘅部落將二戰嘅空兵尊為神，因為佢哋嘅飛機同貨物唔能夠解釋。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Saved beyond hope and glad the land is won, / and lustral rites, with blazing altars, pay / to Jove, and make the shores of Actium gay / with Ilian games, as, like our sires, we strip / and oil our sinews for the wrestler's play. / Proud, thus escaping from the foemen's grip, / past all the Argive towns, through swarming Greeks, to slip.

jyutping: gau3 zo2 ciu1 ceot1 hei1 mong6，hou2 hoi1 sam1 ne1 faai3 dei2 ji5 ging1 jeng4 zo2， / tung4 maai4 gwong1 zaak6 ji4 sik1，jung6 jin4 siu1 ge3 zai3 taan4，bei2 cin4 / bei2 zyu1 bei3 dak6，tung4 maai4 ling6 aa3 hak1 dai3 mou5 ge3 hoi2 ngon6 bin3 dak1 tung4 sing3 lyun2 / jung6 ji1 lei6 on1 jau4 hei3，jan1 wai6，hou2 ci5 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fu6 can1 gam2，ngo5 dei6 wai6 zo2 seot1 gok3 sau2 ge3 waan2 faat3 ji4 bok1 gwong1 / tung4 maai4 jau4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gan1 gwat1。 / giu1 ngou6，gam2 joeng2 tou4 lei4 dik6 jan4 ge3 zoeng2 hung3， / gwo3 zo2 so2 jau5 aa3 ji5 gwo1 si1 sing4 zan3，cyun1 gwo3 jung2 jap6 ge3 hei1 laap6 jan4，heoi3 waat6 gwo3。
text: 救咗超出希望，好開心呢塊地已經贏咗， / 同埋光澤儀式，用燃燒嘅祭壇，畀錢 / 畀朱庇特，同埋令阿克蒂姆嘅海岸變得同性戀 / 用伊利安遊戲，因為，好似我哋嘅父親噉，我哋為咗摔角手嘅玩法而剝光 / 同埋油我哋嘅筋骨。 / 驕傲，噉樣逃離敵人嘅掌控， / 過咗所有阿爾戈斯城鎮，穿過湧入嘅希臘人，去滑過。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The word for Finns in most European languages derives from the name given to them by ancient Germanic peoples, which probably meant 'finders (of food)' or 'wanderers', reflecting that, in those distant times, Finns were still hunter-gatherers lacking a fixed abode, while Germanic tribes had already switched to sedentary agriculture. The Finnish name for their country, 'Suomi', is related to the name of their Sami neighbours; its etymology remains unclear.

jyutping: daai6 bou6 fan6 au1 zau1 jyu5 jin4 jap6 min6「Finns」（fan1 laan4 jan4）ni1 go3 zi6，jyun4 zi6 gu2 doi6 jat6 ji5 maan6 man4 zuk6 bei2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ming4 cing1，ni1 go3 ming4 cing1 daai6 koi3 ji3 si1 hai6「mik6 sik6 ze2」（finders of food）waak6 ze2「lau4 long6 ze2」（wanderers），faan2 jing2 hai2 go2 go3 jiu4 jyun5 si4 doi6，fan1 laan4 jan4 jing4 jin4 hai6 lip6 jan4 coi2 zaap6 ze2，mou5 gu3 ding6 geoi1 so2，ji4 jat6 ji5 maan6 bou6 lok6 ji5 ging1 zyun2 hoeng3 ding6 geoi1 nung4 jip6。fan1 laan4 jan4 zi6 gei2 deoi3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 ming4 cing1「Suomi」，tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 leon4 geoi1 saat3 mai5 jan4（Sami）ge3 ming4 cing1 jau5 gwaan1；daan6 keoi5 ge3 jyu5 jyun4 zi3 gam1 jing4 jin4 mei6 jau5 ding6 leon6。
text: 大部分歐洲語言入面「Finns」（芬蘭人）呢個字，源自古代日耳曼民族畀佢哋嘅名稱，呢個名稱大概意思係「覓食者」（finders of food）或者「流浪者」（wanderers），反映喺嗰個遙遠時代，芬蘭人仍然係獵人採集者，冇固定居所，而日耳曼部落已經轉向定居農業。芬蘭人自己對國家嘅名稱「Suomi」，同佢哋嘅鄰居薩米人（Sami）嘅名稱有關；但佢嘅語源至今仍然未有定論。
